title: What if you biked through a lake of whisky?
caption:
Whisky is thicker than water. Literally. 🥃🚲

At 40% alcohol it's lighter than water, so you sink lower. But alcohol–water mixtures are almost 3× more viscous than water, so every pedal stroke drags.

Above ~26 °C, the vapour over the lake can ignite, and alcohol flames are nearly invisible in daylight.

The real victim? Your chain. Alcohol strips the oil right off.

Which would you rather cycle through: whisky, honey or mercury? 👇
